description: Use when you need to know whether a website or mail server has a valid HTTPS certificate or when it expires: opens a live TLS connection (SNI) to the host and returns whether the chain is publicly trusted (with the exact error, e.g. CERT_HAS_EXPIRED or self-signed), whether the certificate matches the hostname, validity dates and days remaining, subject, issuer, SAN list, key type, TLS protocol, cipher, ALPN and the certificate chain. Answers about the certificate even when it is invalid (that is the point); unreachable hosts are not charged. Hosts served by Cloudflare's own network cannot be probed live from our Workers; for those the response has live:false and shows the newest unexpired certificate logged for the host in Certificate Transparency (trusted:null). Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.003 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
